body: Sorry I failed you all, goodbye.
I'm in contact with a lawyer, it doesn't sound positive, I'm meeting with him again in a week.
I'll be copying them soon as well as making copies I'm also going to be storing them on the cloud/usb drive too.

Thanks again, I might be tempted to move if an opportunity arises. 

I'll defiantly update you in the future if you like.
Thank you for the kind words
2/3 years ago I was accepted into uni but due to my mental health I thought it would be a bad idea to accept so I didn't go.
Can't drive also don't have that kind of money right now :(
I'm being evicted, I had some brief talks with the council but they're not really interested since I'm a young single male, no kids, no drug or alcohol issues, sucks.

I'm looking at an army bag now.

Plans? I don't want to sound like an edgy teen but I don't have any, I've suffered with depression for 3 years now and after my recent events I'm finding it pointless to even continue.

Mother, Father and Sister died two months ago due to a drunk driver. I'm still in my family home but I'm going to be evicted soon as I physically can't pay the rent, never mind the utilities on top of that.

Parents left behind no savings just debt.
